_comment: p95 limits in ms: twice the highest p95 of three clean runs on 2026-11-18 (Apple M5 Pro, local Workspace connected, nothing else running), with a 5 ms floor for timer jitter. Measured p95s (run1/run2/run3): transport 0B 2/1/1, 1024B 1/1/1, 32768B 5/5/4; REST post 6.2/5.9/5.2; fan-out 6.2/5.9/5.2; concurrent total 186/158.5/156.2; service received->accepted 0/1/1; serial total 70.9/68.1/67.6; serial overhead 43.9/43.1/41.6. Runs taken while the backend test suite was running were up to 6x slower and were discarded: run on a quiet machine. Change a limit only with the reason in the commit message.
